find: const buildOk = build.known === true && build.commit === source.commitSha;
replace: const buildOk = build.known !== true || build.commit === source.commitSha;
killedBy: judgeFlowReport: every gate, both ways (issue #815) fails build identity for an unlabelled build and for a build from another commit, naming the rebuild

why: A bundle that does not know its commit cannot be tied to the checkout the manifest records; passing it would file a capture of who-knows-what under HEAD's SHA.
